name: google
description: Gmail and Google Calendar — read freely in chat, send/create only after a Telegram confirmation
capability_note: You can read the user's Gmail and Google Calendar when they ask. You can draft emails, replies and calendar events, but you cannot send or create them yourself: every draft waits for the user to tap a confirm button in Telegram. If Google is not connected, tell them to run /p.google.connect.

tools.name: gmail_search
tools.description: Search the user's Gmail. Uses Gmail search syntax. Empty = recent unread.

tools.name: gmail_read
tools.description: Read one email in full by its id (from gmail_search).

tools.name: gmail_draft
tools.description: Draft an email or a reply. It is NOT sent: the user confirms it with a button in Telegram.

arg.description: Pipe-separated: to|subject|body   or, to answer a mail, reply:<message id>|body

tools.name: gcal_draft_event
tools.description: Draft a Google Calendar event. It is NOT created: the user confirms it with a button in Telegram.

arg.description: Pipe-separated: summary|start|end|location. start/end are ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-09-21T14:00:00+07:00

telegram_commands.description: Sign in to Google (step 1: get the link)
Sign in to Google (step 2: paste the localhost address)
Sign out and revoke the token
